name: Wedding Coffee Cart Hire

heroImage.alt: Sip Social coffee cart serving guests at a wedding reception

body:
A Little Love, A Latte Coffee ☕🤎

Your perfect day deserves the perfect coffee.

Add a little something special to your wedding day with Sip Social, our beautifully designed mobile coffee bar bringing the café experience straight to your celebration.

From morning preparations and post-ceremony pick me ups to evening celebrations, we're here to keep the love (and coffee) flowing.

Serving freshly brewed barista coffee, indulgent hot chocolates, chai lattes and more, our stylish coffee bar is the perfect addition to your big day.

With flexible packages and personalised branding options, including custom cups and coffee bar signage, we can make your coffee experience as unique as your wedding.

Something borrowed, something brewed.

Available for weddings across Surrey, Hampshire and beyond
highlights: Perfect for getting ready, pre ceremony or evening celebrations
Personalised cups & signage to match your wedding
A unique treat for your wedding guests
Flexible packages to suit your special day

faqs.q: How much space does the cart need?
faqs.a: Enough for the cart itself and room for us to work and for a short queue to form — in practice a few metres is normally plenty. We'll confirm the exact footprint once we know your venue.
Yes, weather and venue access allowing. We'll talk through the specifics of your location, including power and any cover, when you enquire.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.a: As early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed. Wedding season weekends go first.
